label: m
description: MADE-LAND: mixed texture materials dumped or built (mill tailings, spoil) (GSC OF 837, Vancouver NM-9/10, legend for Quaternary of Canadian Cordillera, compiled by R.J. Fulton, J.J. Clague, J.M. Ryder 1982)

label: I
description: ALPINE GLACIERS AND ICE CAPS: ice and debris covered ice; minor glacial deposits and small areas of rock (nunataks)

label: O
description: ORGANIC DEPOSITS: peat, mucky peat and muck, 1-4 m, rarely to 15 m

label: S
description: LANDSLIDE: rubble and diamicton; small rockfalls, hummocky valley fills, large fans of rubble, earthflows; up to 80 m

label: Fc
description: FLUVIAL Fc: dominantly channel sands and gravels and associated terraces

label: Fo
description: FLUVIAL Fo: dominantly fine grained sand and silt overbank deposits

label: Ff
description: FLUVIAL Ff: diamicton and gravel of alluvial fans

label: Fx
description: FLUVIAL Fx: complex of channel and overbank deposits and colluvial and alluvial fans in mountain valleys

label: Lt
description: LACUSTRINE Lt: thick lacustrine silt, clay and sand (rhythmites), terrace or dissected valley fill, < 100 m

label: Lx
description: LACUSTRINE Lx: lacustrine silt, sand and clay and minor ice contact sand and gravel, hummocky, < 10 m

label: Wt
description: MARINE AND GLACIOMARINE Wt: thick deposits masking relief, silt, clay and stony silt and clay

label: Wb
description: MARINE AND GLACIOMARINE Wb: deposits thick enough to mask minor irregularities

label: Wv
description: MARINE AND GLACIOMARINE Wv: discontinuous thin deposits, relief of underlying units

label: Gt
description: GLACIOFLUVIAL Gt: sand and gravel in terraces and deltas

label: Gx
description: GLACIOFLUVIAL Gx: sand and gravel in ridges and hummocks (kames, eskers), ice contact

label: lM
description: LOAMY TILL (cover letter not legible)

label: lMt
description: LOAMY TILL lMt: continuous till cover, > 10 m on valley floors and lower slopes

label: lMb
description: LOAMY TILL lMb: continuous till cover 1-3 m

label: lMv
description: LOAMY TILL lMv: thin to discontinuous till with scattered outcrops

label: dM
description: SANDY LOAMY TILL (cover letter not legible)

label: dMt
description: SANDY LOAMY TILL dMt: continuous till cover > 10 m

label: dMb
description: SANDY LOAMY TILL dMb: continuous till cover 1-3 m

label: dMv
description: SANDY LOAMY TILL dMv: thin to discontinuous till with scattered outcrops, < 2 m

label: sM
description: SANDY TILL (cover letter not legible)

label: sMt
description: SANDY TILL sMt: continuous till cover up to 10 m

label: sMb
description: SANDY TILL sMb: continuous till cover 1-3 m

label: sMv
description: SANDY TILL sMv: thin to discontinuous till with scattered outcrops, < 2 m

label: Mt
description: TILL t (texture prefix not legible): continuous till cover

label: Mb
description: TILL b (texture prefix not legible): continuous till cover 1-3 m

label: Mv
description: TILL v (texture prefix not legible): thin to discontinuous till

label: Ra
description: ROCK WITH DISCONTINUOUS COLLUVIUM AND TILL, ALPINE MOUNTAINS Ra: aretes, cirques, glaciated valleys; discontinuous colluvial rubble, aprons and cones; till veneer on lower valley walls

label: Rs
description: ROCK WITH DISCONTINUOUS COLLUVIUM AND TILL, STEEP SLOPES Rs: discontinuous colluvial rubble, thin patches of till, < 2 m

label: Rm
description: ROCK WITH MINOR COLLUVIUM AND TILL, LOW RELIEF Rm: flat to gently rolling rock, patches of peat, colluvium and till

label: Qv
description: QUATERNARY VOLCANICS Qv: lava flows, breccia and ash, basaltic and andesitic, cinder cones
